q: In a circular motion, the object just moves in a ____.
e: Circular motion means the object travels on a circular path. The blank is circle, because a straight line or a parabola is a different kind of path.

q: In rotational motion, the object rotates about an ____.
e: In rotational motion, the object rotates about an axis. Rotational motion means a body spins about an axis.

q: A rigid body is a body that does not ____ or change shape.
e: A rigid body is a body that does not deform or change shape. A rigid body keeps a fixed shape, so it does not deform.

q: In a rigid body, no matter how the body moves, the ____ between any two particles within the body remains constant.
e: In a rigid body, no matter how the body moves, the distance between any two particles within the body remains constant. In a rigid body the distance between any two particles stays constant.

q: If a rigid body is in rotational motion, all the particles constituting it undergo circular motion about a common ____.
e: If a rigid body is in rotational motion, all the particles constituting it undergo circular motion about a common axis. Rotational motion means a body spins about an axis.

q: When an object (rigid body) rotates, it can speed up (or) ____ down.
e: When an object (rigid body) rotates, it can speed up (or) slow down. A rigid body keeps a fixed shape, so the distance between any two of its particles stays constant.

q: During the time intervals when an object speeds up or slows down, its angular velocity is changing therefore it has an angular ____.
e: During the time intervals when an object speeds up or slows down, its angular velocity is changing therefore it has an angular acceleration. Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity, written a or α.

q: If the angular velocity changes at a constant rate, the angular acceleration is ____.
e: If the angular velocity changes at a constant rate, the angular acceleration is constant. Angular acceleration α is the rate of change of angular velocity ω.

q: Rotational variables include angular displacement, angular velocity, and angular ____.
e: Rotational variables include angular displacement, angular velocity, and angular acceleration. Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity, written a or α.

q: The kinematic equations for rotational motion are derived for an object that rotates with a constant angular ____.
e: The kinematic equations for rotational motion are derived for an object that rotates with a constant angular acceleration. Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity, written a or α.

q: The magnitude of angular velocity of the object at $t=0$ is called the initial angular ____.
e: The magnitude of angular velocity of the object at t=0 is called the initial angular speed. Speed is the magnitude of velocity.

q: The equations of motion for constant angular acceleration are analogous to equations for constant acceleration in ____ motion.
e: The equations of motion for constant angular acceleration are analogous to equations for constant acceleration in linear motion. Angular acceleration α is the rate of change of angular velocity ω.

q: In Grade 10, kinematic equations were derived for linear motion with constant ____.
e: In Grade 10, kinematic equations were derived for linear motion with constant acceleration. Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity, written a or α.

q: According to the summary, angular acceleration is constant if the angular velocity changes at a constant ____.
e: According to the summary, angular acceleration is constant if the angular velocity changes at a constant rate. Angular acceleration α is the rate of change of angular velocity ω.

q: Motion with a constant rate of change of angular velocity is called rotational motion under constant angular ____.
e: Motion with a constant rate of change of angular velocity is called rotational motion under constant angular acceleration. Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity, written a or α.

q: The summary states that for uniform circular motion, the centripetal acceleration vector points towards the ____ of the circular path.
e: The summary states that for uniform circular motion, the centripetal acceleration vector points towards the centre of the circular path. The centre of the circle is where a_C and F_c point.

q: The summary notes that the linear velocity vector is ____ to the circular path.
e: The summary notes that the linear velocity vector is tangential to the circular path. Tangential means along the tangent to the circular path.

q: The acceleration directed towards the centre of the circular path is called ____ acceleration.
e: The acceleration directed towards the centre of the circular path is called centripetal acceleration. Centripetal means toward the centre of the circle.

q: The angular acceleration is equal to ____ when there is no change in angular velocity.
e: The angular acceleration is equal to zero when there is no change in angular velocity. A limit as Δt → 0 is the instantaneous rate, so that increment goes to zero.
